entries.title: Critical honeycomb O(1) interface is Ising/SLE(3)
entries.statement: In the honeycomb O(n) loop model with one boundary interface, n=1 and critical edge weight z=1/sqrt(3) correspond to the Ising case, whose interface has a proved SLE(3) limit. The existing C0096 math-brain card calls that n=1 critical case site percolation; the cited primary source identifies it as Ising. This corrects only that parenthetical and does not imply the n=0 SAW scaling limit.
assumptions: boundary interface and boundary conditions as in BDGS Section 3.4
source-fidelity correction pending second referee before live-store replacement

source.excerpt: For n=1 and z=1/sqrt(3), it has been proved that the interface converges to SLE_3

relations.rationale: The new card states critical n=1 is Ising/SLE(3); the existing C0096 card says critical n=1 is site percolation. The BDGS source explicitly supports the Ising/SLE(3) reading. Review the existing card's parenthetical before superseding it.
The new card concerns n=1 critical Ising interfaces and SLE(3); the existing P0003 card asks about n=0 fixed-length honeycomb SAW and SLE(8/3). These are different model parameters and ensembles.
